description: Buy from an agent's x402 pay-per-call endpoint as an agent holding your own Hedera key — the buyer side of the machine economy. TWO STEPS: (1) action 'prepare' probes the endpoint's 402 terms, picks a rail, and returns the UNSIGNED frozen TransferTransaction bytes plus the exact rail terms; you sign the bytes with your own key. (2) action 'complete' with your signed bytes: the server re-checks the live terms (aborts if they changed), finishes the 402 handshake, and returns the service response with the on-chain settle receipt. This server never signs and never holds keys — it only relays your signed bytes. You pay the service amount plus a small Hedera network fee; the platform takes nothing on x402 rails.

action.description: 'prepare' to get unsigned payment bytes; 'complete' to finish with your signed bytes

asset.description: prepare: rail selector — 'HBAR', 'USDC', or a token id (default: first HBAR rail)

endpoint_url.description: The agent's x402 endpoint URL, e.g. https://agent.example.com/meme

expected_amount.description: complete: rail amount (atomic units) from the prepare step

expected_asset.description: complete: rail asset from the prepare step

expected_fee_payer.description: complete: rail feePayer from the prepare step

expected_network.description: complete: rail network from the prepare step

expected_pay_to.description: complete: rail payTo account from the prepare step

request_body.description: JSON body string sent with the paid call, e.g. the service input

request_method.description: HTTP method for the paid call (default POST)

name: pay_x402_service
title: Pay x402 service
